exact_support_requires: task/semantic-unit rows are fixed independently of STRI outcomes
positive support edges have author/released executable or contractual provenance
zero edges are justified by the released support contract rather than absence from a retrieval/availability list
the candidate does not use downstream success/failure to define support
qualification_rule.analogue_allowed_when: The released object is an author/expert task-skill selection or relevance graph but omitted edges are not proven unsupported.

candidates.name: AgentSkillOS benchmark oracle sets
candidates.paper: Organizing, Orchestrating, and Benchmarking Agent Skills at Ecosystem Scale
candidates.released_object: 30 task JSON files with author-specified skills lists; workflow specified mode passes those skill names directly and skips discovery
candidates.zero_edge_provenance: not sufficient: absence from task.skills does not prove inability to support the task

candidates.name: SWE-Skills-Bench
candidates.paper: SWE-Skills-Bench: Do Agent Skills Actually Help in Real-World Software Engineering?
candidates.released_object: 49 paired records, each binding one skill_id and skill document to one task/repository and deterministic test_code
candidates.positive_edge_provenance: benchmark pairing identifies the tested skill-task intervention
candidates.zero_edge_provenance: not sufficient: no released complete 49x49 cross-skill applicability/support matrix; pytest verifies task output, not semantic inability of omitted skills
candidates.reopen_condition: A released or independently preregistered complete cross-skill applicability/support contract with justified zero edges.

candidates.name: SkillLearnBench
candidates.paper: SkillLearnBench: Benchmarking Continual Learning Methods for Agent Skill Generation on Real-World Tasks
candidates.released_object: 20 skill-dependent tasks / 100 verified instances with task verifiers and task-local human-authored/generated skills
candidates.positive_edge_provenance: task-local skill dependence and verifier-backed downstream evaluation
candidates.zero_edge_provenance: not sufficient: no complete all-task x all-skill semantic support relation
candidates.reopen_condition: A complete author-defined or executable support matrix over the released task and skill pool.

candidates.name: SkillsBench task-local skill availability
candidates.released_object: task-local installed skill directories and incomplete required_skills metadata
candidates.zero_edge_provenance: not sufficient; 79/87 task metadata/local-availability mismatches in the frozen qualification audit

candidates.name: SkillRouter expert relevance graph
candidates.paper: SkillRouter: Retrieve-and-Rerank Skill Selection for LLM Agents at Scale
candidates.zero_edge_provenance: relevance exclusion, not executable semantic inability

summary.next_scientific_reopen_if_more_breadth_n: Prefer a preregistered multi-task behavioral replication on a first-party released control seam over relabeling relevance/availability as support.
